result.title: Logic Hijacking of RAG: Single-Document Poisoning via Local Optimization
result.summary: Single-document corpus poisoning under black-box access poses a severe threat to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, existing attacks predominantly rely on explicit factual refutations or imperative instruction overrides. Modern aligned LLMs often arbitrate such conflicts conservatively, rejecting overt contradictions in favor of parametric memory or clean retrieved context while triggering input guardrails. We propose MONOLOGUE, a single-document poisoning framework based on Logic Hijacking without explicit refutation. Rather than disputing the ground truth, our method concedes it as an authoritative historical baseline before introducing the update, weaving a grounded record-correction narrative (e.g., dated institutional reattributions) that presents the counterfactual target as the most recent update. To prevent suspicious live writes, payloads are refined entirely offline via local multi-dimensional gated optimization, coupling automated text quality audits with surrogate behavioral verification. Evaluations across three benchmarks, three retrieval backends, and four open-weight generator regimes show that our method achieves the strongest overall attack efficacy among the evaluated single-document poisoning attacks.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 MONOLOGUE，一种黑盒单文档 RAG 投毒框架：不直接反驳事实，而是把真值承认为「历史基线」，再以带日期的「记录更正」叙事把反事实目标包装成最新更新，并通过离线的多维门控局部优化与替代模型行为验证来精炼投毒文本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离线、替代模型引导的离散证据文本优化」与「检索证据同参数记忆冲突时如何裁决」的设定，可能可供核查用于构造受控证据干预、检验 VLM 推理是否真正使用所提供的视觉/文本证据。
